prompts.name: lee_up
prompts.prompt: Upscale and restore this low-resolution video frame into a sharp, clean, high-resolution photo. This is a photo restoration task only: keep EXACTLY the same person, same face shape, same eyes, eyebrows, nose, mouth, expression, gaze direction, hair, clothing, pose, framing, lighting and dark night background. Do not change, beautify, or re-imagine his facial features. Only remove blur, compression artifacts and noise and add natural fine detail (skin texture, hair strands, fabric). No text, no watermark.
